title: Jimani — Multi-Tenant Business Platform
shortDescription: Enterprise SaaS platform serving Restaurants, Salons, Webshops, and Activity businesses from a single multi-tenant application.
description: Jimani is a comprehensive multi-tenant SaaS platform designed to unify business management across multiple verticals. The platform enables restaurants, salons, webshops, and activity-based businesses to manage their operations, reservations, billing, and customer engagement from a single cohesive interface.
problem: Business owners managing multiple outlets had no unified system to handle reservations, POS, kitchen operations, and customer management simultaneously. Existing solutions were either too expensive or lacked the flexibility for multi-business-type operations.
responsibilities: Designed and implemented the floor plan builder module with drag-and-drop capabilities
Built the entire reservation lifecycle management workflow
Developed POS billing system integrated with kitchen and webshop modules
Implemented CQRS architecture ensuring clean command/query separation
Built multilingual support system with customer-uploaded resource files
Developed responsive UI optimized for touch-enabled POS devices
architecture: Multi-tenant ASP.NET Core application using CQRS pattern with separate command and query pipelines. Entity Framework Core handles data access with SQL Server as the primary database. The UI layer uses Razor Views with Bootstrap and AJAX for real-time updates.

features.title: Interactive Floor Plan Builder
features.description: Drag-and-drop canvas allowing businesses to design custom floor layouts with tables, chairs, decorations, and seating arrangements.

features.title: Reservation Management
features.description: Real-time reservation workflow with automated table status transitions: Reserved → Guest Arrived → Seated → Food Ordered → Completed.

features.title: Point of Sale (POS)
features.description: Full-featured POS system with billing, order processing, and payment workflows tightly integrated with reservations and webshop.

features.title: Kitchen Management
features.description: Kitchen order management workflows enabling seamless communication between POS terminals and kitchen operations.

features.title: Multilingual Support
features.description: Dynamic localization system where customers upload their own language resource files, enabling instant language switching.

challenges: Designing a floor plan system that was intuitive for non-technical business owners while being data-efficient for real-time updates
Handling multi-tenant data isolation at scale without compromising query performance
Synchronizing POS, reservation, and kitchen state in real time across concurrent users
businessImpact: Enabled businesses to reduce reservation conflicts by 60%, streamline kitchen operations, and serve customers faster through integrated POS workflows.

title: HRMS — Human Resource Management System
shortDescription: End-to-end HRMS covering attendance tracking, payroll automation, employee self-service, appraisals, and incident management.
description: A comprehensive Human Resource Management System built to digitize and automate core HR operations. The system covers the full employee lifecycle from onboarding through payroll and performance management.
problem: HR teams were using spreadsheets and manual processes for attendance, payroll, and compliance, leading to errors, delays, and poor employee experience.
responsibilities: Developed attendance management module with shift management and leave tracking
Built automated payroll calculation engine with configurable salary structures
Implemented employee self-service portal for leave requests, payslips, and queries
Designed appraisal workflow with configurable review cycles and KPI tracking
Built incident management module for HR compliance and disciplinary procedures
Designed comprehensive HR reporting suite for attendance, payroll, and employee analytics
architecture: ASP.NET Web Forms and MVC application with SQL Server backend. Stored procedures handle complex payroll calculations and reporting. The system uses a layered architecture with separate business logic, data access, and presentation layers.

features.title: Attendance & Leave Management
features.description: Automated attendance tracking with biometric integration support, shift management, and multi-type leave policy engine.

features.title: Payroll Automation
features.description: Configurable payroll engine supporting variable pay components, deductions, tax calculations, and bulk payslip generation.

features.title: Employee Self-Service
features.description: Employee portal for submitting requests, viewing payslips, managing personal information, and tracking appraisal status.

features.title: Appraisal Management
features.description: Configurable performance review cycles with KPI tracking, multi-level approvals, and historical appraisal records.

features.title: HR Analytics & Reports
features.description: Comprehensive reporting suite covering attendance trends, payroll summaries, appraisal statistics, and compliance reports.

challenges: Designing a payroll engine flexible enough to handle diverse salary structures across clients
Optimizing report generation queries for large employee datasets without performance degradation
Building an audit trail system meeting HR compliance requirements
businessImpact: Reduced payroll processing time by 40%, eliminated manual attendance reconciliation, and provided HR teams with real-time workforce analytics.

title: Fisco Flow — Finance Management System
shortDescription: Finance management platform covering invoice automation, cheque processing, bank reconciliation, and government compliance workflows.
description: Fisco Flow is an enterprise finance management application designed to digitize and automate the complete financial operations of medium to large businesses, with particular focus on government compliance requirements.
problem: Finance teams were manually generating invoices, tracking cheques, and completing MEPZ compliance forms — a process consuming significant time and prone to human error.
responsibilities: Developed invoice generation module with automated email attachment functionality
Built cheque processing and tracking workflow
Implemented bank account management and reconciliation features
Designed and implemented MEPZ government compliance form generation
Built automated submission workflows for government reporting
Developed finance reporting dashboards and analytics
architecture: ASP.NET Core MVC application with SQL Server. Uses a service layer pattern with repository abstraction. Invoice generation leverages server-side PDF rendering with automatic email dispatch via SMTP.

features.title: Invoice Automation
features.description: Automated invoice generation with PDF export and email attachment functionality, supporting configurable templates and batch processing.

features.title: Cheque Management
features.description: End-to-end cheque lifecycle tracking from issuance through clearance with status notifications and reconciliation reporting.

features.title: MEPZ Compliance
features.description: Automated generation and submission of MEPZ government compliance forms, eliminating manual form-filling for export zone businesses.

features.title: Bank Reconciliation
features.description: Automated bank statement matching and reconciliation workflow with exception reporting for unmatched transactions.

challenges: Building a compliant MEPZ form generation engine that matched exact government specifications
Designing a flexible invoice template system supporting multiple business formats
Implementing reliable automated email delivery with attachment tracking
businessImpact: Reduced invoice processing time by 70%, eliminated manual MEPZ form preparation, and improved finance team efficiency through automated reconciliation.

title: MyVoice — Employee Engagement Platform
shortDescription: Internal web application focused on improving organizational operations and employee engagement with payroll automation and user management.
description: MyVoice is an employee engagement and operations platform built to bridge communication gaps between employees and management, with integrated payroll automation and workflow management tools.
problem: Organizations lacked a unified platform for employee feedback, workflow requests, and payroll visibility — resulting in communication silos and delayed process approvals.
responsibilities: Developed payroll automation module with configurable salary and deduction rules
Built user management system with role-based access control
Implemented workflow enhancement features for process approvals
Developed employee engagement features including feedback and announcement modules
architecture: PHP web application with MySQL database. Uses a custom MVC-style framework with Bootstrap frontend and jQuery for dynamic interactions.

features.title: Payroll Automation
features.description: Automated payroll calculation with configurable components and tax deductions.

features.title: User Management
features.description: Role-based access control with department-level permissions and audit logging.

features.title: Workflow Engine
features.description: Configurable approval workflows for leave, expense claims, and HR requests.

challenges: Building a flexible workflow engine supporting diverse approval chain configurations
Ensuring data consistency across concurrent payroll processing operations
businessImpact: Improved employee engagement, reduced approval cycle times, and provided management with better operational visibility.
